claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Parachlorophenol is a phenolic antiseptic that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive in a 5-day pooled viability screen, since its cytotoxic effects in the literature are only observed at much higher concentrations (millimolar range) on dental and periodontal cells.
